{"items": ["[passage_read_so_far]
- Hyde vanishes after Sir Danvers's murder; rewards are offered.（the man in the middle、Sir Danvers Carew）
- Jekyll emerges from seclusion and resumes his old friendships.（Dr. Jekyll）
- Utterson dines with Jekyll and Lanyon as inseparable friends.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll、Dr. Lanyon）
- Jekyll shuts his door against Utterson, Poole reporting he is confined.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll、Poole）
- Utterson visits Lanyon and is shocked by his decayed appearance.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Lanyon）
- Lanyon declares himself a doomed man who will never recover.（Dr. Lanyon）
- Lanyon refuses to hear Jekyll's name, calling him dead to him.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Lanyon）
- Utterson writes to Jekyll, who replies of an incurable quarrel.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll vows extreme seclusion and speaks of an unnameable punishment.（Dr. Jekyll）
- Lanyon takes to his bed and dies within a fortnight.（Dr. Lanyon）
- After the funeral Utterson opens Lanyon's sealed envelope.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Lanyon）
- The enclosure is not to be opened till Jekyll's death or disappearance.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Utterson prefers speaking with Poole at the door rather than entering.（Mr. Utterson、Poole）
- Poole reports Jekyll confines himself over the laboratory and is silent.（Dr. Jekyll、Poole）
